semanticTargetModel: Each operation owns one semantic target; a plan coordinates the complete physical write set across targets.

targetFromPaths.projectile: Freshly resolve the projectile selected by a prior projectile-reference operation.
targetFromPaths.terminal.impact: Freshly resolve that resulting projectile's impact terminal slot.
targetFromPaths.terminal.expiry: Freshly resolve that resulting projectile's expiry terminal slot.

grouping.samePhase: Independent targets whose identities do not change are resolved together and guarded as one complete physical write set.
grouping.newPhaseRequired: A reference replacement that changes a later semantic target requires target_from in a subsequent phase.
grouping.order: phase index, then operation declaration index, then change declaration index

sharedScope.rule: allow_shared=true authorizes only the semantic object targeted by that operation.
sharedScope.backingObjectRule: One operation may contain fields from exactly one owning component/settings object; split ProjectileSettings, DamageInfo, ExplosionSettings, and explosion DamageInfo into separate operations.

execution: complete phase write-set validation before protection changes
stable reread of every participating context
